info.title: THROWAWAY nubl A0 slice 3 B2
info.description: Throwaway only. Unix socket, owned modes and per-caller bearer grants. Same-user code can read grants. No hidden retries.

post.summary: Explicit fresh process after confirmed cleanup; opens history without prompting

200.description: Supervisor-wide SSE with filters. Bounded subscriber queue; final overflow frame then close. Fresh authoritative snapshot required on every reconnect.

Cursor.description: Transport epoch in worker_epoch is independent of the worker binding epoch and changes on every supervisor start.

GitPin.description: Launch-time Git pointer bytes of a sandbox root. Relaunch and owner Git commands refuse when any value changed.

Snapshot.description: Supervisor snapshot. worker/history only on a single-worker filter (legacy convenience); workers is authoritative. Fresh snapshot on every attach; no event replay.

termination.description: observed_stopped: normal stop, generation confirmed gone. superseded_generation_stopped: old generation gone but a new relaunch was already running. superseded_generation_unknown: old generation cleanup outcome unknown, new generation running. unknown: cleanup outcome unknown, generation status not checked.

stopped_worker_epoch.description: The worker_epoch of the generation that was targeted by this stop. Present for all termination values.

current_worker_epoch.description: The worker_epoch of the currently active generation at the time of receipt. Equals stopped_worker_epoch for non-superseded stops; differs when the generation was superseded.
